description: IPv6 address a host builds for itself from a /64 prefix and a MAC (SLAAC, RFC 4862). The interface id is the modified EUI-64. The prefix must be exactly 64 bits and the low 64 bits of the prefix must be zero. Also returns the link-local address and the solicited-node multicast address. Text is RFC 5952. No zone index and no IPv4 tail. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/slaac-address
name: slaac_address
title: Slaac Address
